description: Range Plume is a numeric range slicer drawn over the distribution of your column. Drop a numeric column (price, age, lead time, surface…) in Numeric field and a COUNTROWS measure in Row count: the visual draws the histogram and lets users pick a range with full context, instead of guessing bounds on a blank slider. FREE, NO WATERMARK - Histogram as bars, filled curve or dots; automatic or fixed bins; linear, logarithmic or automatic scale for skewed data - Median and mean markers, axis, tooltip per bin - Drag the handles, drag the whole range, or draw the range directly on the histogram - Exact min / max inputs: "80", "1,200", "1.2k", "3.5M" - Snapping to a step, bin edges or existing values; open-ended bounds at the extremes - Presets: quartiles, "without outliers", above median, top or bottom 10% - Range impact: rows kept, share of rows, measure kept and its share, median of the range - Apply on mouse release or with an Apply / Cancel button - Bookmarks, sync slicers, keyboard handles (arrows, Page Up / Down, Home / End), screen readers, high contrast, themes, English and French - Custom colors: background, text, grid, accent, favorable / unfavorable, 8 series and a 3-color gradient; Minimal and Black & White styles PREMIUM (★, additional purchase) - Custom named ranges that become one-click buttons, for example "Small: -50; Medium: 50-200; Large: 200-" - Style card shared…
